name: jsonata
description: JSONata in DuckDB. Extract, query, and transform JSON with sophisticated path expressions, conditional shaping, array filtering, and reshape rules. Reaches into nested JSON where DuckDB's native operators get verbose.

cta.title: JSONata Inside SQL
cta.description: Install the JSONata extension to evaluate JSONata expressions against JSON columns — for path traversal, conditional reshaping, and aggregation that's awkward in plain SQL.
